about: The owner's later edits to texts of the description (docs/adwamuha/feature-prompt.md), given in chat. Each text is cut from the owner's message by script, never typed. scripts/adwamuha/owner-texts.ts applies them.

hadithCard.note: The light-plan hadith card: the owner's text (2026-10-25) with a shadda on the word Allah (2026-10-29), no source line and no Dorar link; the owner's source line and Dorar's data stay stored.
hadithCard.text: أَحَبُّ الأعمالِ إلى اللّهِ أدْومُها و إن قَلَّ

setupIntent.note: The owner's words at the start of their 4-of-7 line (2026-10-24, the old start screen); kept in the setup's 4-of-7 line (owner, 2026-10-29). Cut from the app's strings by script.

designFixes.note: The owner's corrections to the design's interface texts (2026-10-30): the imperative in the first setup choice, and Home's title above the full morning and evening cards. Cut from their message by script; scripts/adwamuha/design-strings.ts applies them.

wardNames.note: Names shown instead of the first words of these two adhkar, in the setup preview and the ward order (owner, 2026-10-30). Cut from their message by script; each goes with its plan ids (morning, evening): step 5 and step 4.

stepPassed.note: The plan editor's button that marks a step as passed (owner, 2026-11-22: the user already keeps it), with the damma the owner asked for in a second message the same day. Cut from their messages by script.

stepBackTo.note: The step-back sheet's choice of a step to go back to, with − and + (owner, 2026-11-22: before the break; the design approved the same day). Cut from their message by script.

redesign.note: The owner's words for the redesign (approved 2026-11-26), cut from their chat messages by script. They are interface strings in common.json; src/i18n/owner-words.test.ts checks they match.

words.note: Shortens the ward list, with an up arrow (owner, message 3).
The step-back row in «مساري» and «أدومها» settings (owner chose it, message 4).
Puts a step done back in the plan (owner chose it, message 4).

words.text: التسجيلات الصوتية بصوت حمد الدريهم، وأذكار الصباح والمساء بصوت أخٍ متطوّع، جزاه الله خيرًا.
words.note: The owner's sentence (message 3) and their choice of the thanks (message 4), with Claude's words for «سري» in the middle (approved in the design).
